subject: RIDDOR deadline PASSED — {referenceNumber} is overdue
preheader: A reportable incident on {productName} has passed its statutory reporting deadline.
body:
The statutory reporting deadline for incident {referenceNumber} ({categoryLabel}) passed at {deadlineAt} UTC and no submission has been recorded.

Failing to report a RIDDOR-reportable incident is an offence. Submit the report to the HSE immediately and record the submission on the incident — the record of a late submission is still better than none.
footer: You are receiving this because you own this incident or hold incident management permissions in {productName}.
